subject: Onboarding: rolling-netterm-ladder & early-pay enrollment for BlueGrain
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@bluegrain.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: rolling-netterm-ladder & early-pay enrollment for BlueGrain

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the analytics integration. To keep procurement moving and avoid payment delays, we want to propose a small, staged payment-terms plan that helps BlueGrain smooth cash flow while aligning with our PO cadence. High level:

- Initial onboarding period (first 60 days): Net 45 to allow us to validate invoice routing and PO matching.
- After successful invoice routing validation: move to Net 30 on a rolling basis (i.e., after 2 consecutive clean invoice cycles).
- Optional early-pay enrollment: 2% discount if BlueGrain opts into 10-day early payment (2/10 Net 30) — Finance-run pilot for first 3 months.

Action items we need from you to finalize setup:
1) Confirm AP contact and preferred remit email/address (we asked for accounts@ but want a person).
2) Confirm whether you can accept POs with a single reference field (PO#: Redwood-XXXX).
3) Send bank details/W-9 (we can accept via secure portal).
4) Indicate if you want to opt into the early-pay pilot.

I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form and a sample PO to show how fields map. If this approach looks reasonable, I will have Procurement route initial POs as Net 45 while Finance and I run the early-pay pilot cadence.

Thanks — short meeting welcome if you'd prefer to walk through.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), Sample_PO_12345.pdf (pdf)

From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@bluegrain.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding: rolling-netterm-ladder & early-pay enrollment for BlueGrain

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below:

1) AP contact: Rachel Barlow, Senior Accountant <rachel.barlow@bluegrain.io>.
2) We can accept POs with a PO# field; our systems will match to "Reference Number" on the invoice.
3) Attached is our W-9. For bank details, we prefer to share securely — happy to upload to your portal.
4) Early-pay: interested in the pilot; 2% for payment in 10 days sounds workable, but can you confirm whether Redwood will auto-opt invoices or require an enrollment flag per invoice?

Also, two practical items: we invoice monthly on the last business day, and our invoice files include CSV line items. Can that be preserved so your AP can ingest without manual edits?

Thanks — we uploaded W-9_BlueGrain.pdf to your portal and copied accounts@ (accounts@bluegrain.io) on this reply.

Best,
Leah Ortiz
Head of Operations
BlueGrain Analytics
attachments: W-9_BlueGrain.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@bluegrain.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: rolling-netterm-ladder & early-pay enrollment for BlueGrain

Leah —

Perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications and next steps:

- Early-pay enrollment: Finance needs an enrollment flag on the invoice (we won't auto-opt). Please add the term "EARLYPAY-OPTIN" in the invoice header or in the Notes field when you want the 2/10 selection applied. Procurement will confirm eligibility against the pilot list before Finance releases the payment.

- CSV invoices: our AP system can accept CSV attachments provided the header mapping includes Item, Qty, UnitPrice, and Total. I attached a small Sample_PO_12345.pdf that shows the fields we need.

- PO routing & numbers: We'll issue initial onboarding POs as Net 45 and the PO number will be Redwood-ONB-####. Once we verify 2 cycles without exceptions, we'll shift future POs to Net 30 automatically. We'll notify you before the change.

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll submit the onboarding form to Finance (attached completed copy).
2) Priyom will seed the early-pay pilot roster and confirm dates/timeframe.
3) Ben will ensure the PO is dispatched this week so you have an invoice to match to.

Dropping the completed onboarding form here for your records.

Best,
Kim

Team —

Thanks; I'll take Finance lead on the early-pay setup. Short checklist and timeline:

- Today: I will add BlueGrain to the pilot roster (DG-4821) and confirm eligible invoice numbers pattern.
- Wed Apr 16: Finance will confirm technical routing for CSV ingest (mapping sheet attached to internal drive link).
- Fri Apr 18: First onboarding PO (Redwood-ONB-1001) will be issued. BlueGrain to submit invoice on last business day of April; if marked EARLYPAY-OPTIN we will evaluate for 2/10.

Note on approvals: early-pay invoices will route through a one-click approval in our portal; we need BlueGrain to ensure the invoice Notes field contains "EARLYPAY-OPTIN" exactly. If you want, Ben can run a quick sample invoice this week to validate ingest.

@Leah / accounts@bluegrain.io — please confirm Rachel's contact is correct and that you'll include EARLYPAY-OPTIN text when applicable.

I'll follow up with a brief onboarding checklist and a secure upload link for bank details.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
